title: Showroom multi-location, wired end to end (MCP first)

tasks.title: Idempotent backfill: one location row per existing store
tasks.detail: scripts/sql/backfill_showroom_store_locations.sql — INSERT…SELECT…WHERE NOT EXISTS, COALESCE(location_zip_code, zip_code). Applied with wrangler d1 execute --remote --file. Data, not schema, so deliberately not a drizzle migration.

tasks.title: Assert count(locations) == count(stores) on remote
tasks.detail: 221/221 expected. Also assert every store_id appears exactly once.

tasks.title: services/showroom/locations.ts — formatShowroomAddress + loadStoreLocations
tasks.detail: Derived display address from structured parts (with assert self-check); batched location loader chunked at 20 ids for the D1 100-bound-param cap; derived cityName/hubRoute/hubName via classifyBayAreaRegion; isPrimary derived from place_id match, never stored.

tasks.title: get_showroom returns locations[] + locationCount
tasks.detail: Description rewritten so an agent knows a store has MANY sites before it proposes overwriting one.

tasks.title: list_showrooms: locationCount per row + multiLocationOnly filter
tasks.detail: Answers 'which showrooms are chains with more than one Bay Area site' — a question that had no query before.

tasks.title: add_showroom_location tool
tasks.detail: Adds a site to an existing store. Pre-checks the place_id unique index and names the owning store on collision. Dual-writes the legacy showroom_stores columns only when the new row is the primary.

tasks.title: update_showroom_location tool
tasks.detail: Patch one location by locationId; only passed fields change; dual-writes when primary.

tasks.title: delete_showroom_location tool (DESTRUCTIVE)
tasks.detail: Refuses to delete a store's last remaining location.

tasks.title: find_known_showrooms + search_showrooms match location place_ids
tasks.detail: Root-cause fix: new sites only ever carry a place_id on the LOCATION row. Matching only showroom_stores.place_id makes a chain's second site read as 'not registered', which is how duplicate stores get created.

tasks.title: scripts/qc/pr_<n>.mjs — preview + prod
tasks.detail: Exercises the three new tools, the two changed reads, the dedupe fix, and asserts legacy/primary address parity.

successCriteria: get_showroom returns a locations[] array for every store
list_showrooms({ multiLocationOnly: true }) returns only chains
add_showroom_location adds a San Carlos site to an Emeryville-registered store without touching the Emeryville row
find_known_showrooms matching a chain's second site reports the OWNING store, not 'none'
QC green on preview and prod
